name: Nerima-Kasugacho
tagline: Shinjuku in 24 minutes and Shibuya in 34 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Nerima City, served by Toei Oedo Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 43 minutes to Otemachi, 24 minutes to Shinjuku, 34 minutes to Shibuya and 53 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 38.8 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 2.8 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 38.8 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 37.1 m to 39.9 m, a difference of 2.8 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 4 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is less than 0.5 m. The station itself is inside the projected area, but few of the points around it are. Compared with other stations in the 23 wards, the flood projection here is on the small side.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 6 clinics and 5 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 練馬光が丘病院, about 21 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 忠医会病院, about 22 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Toei Oedo Line.
congestion: Toei Oedo Line runs at 147% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 中井→東中野; trains from here toward 東中野 pass through it. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥130,000 to ¥140,000 and 2LDK ¥160,000 to ¥170,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the low side. What holds the figure down: only one line, the {line}, serving the station and little daily shopping within walking distance.

neighbours.lead: For lower rent, Toshimaen; for safety, Nerima-Kasugacho.
neighbours.note: About 1.5 km from Nerima-Kasugacho in a straight line. Both have the Toei Oedo Line. Toshimaen also has the Seibu Toshima Line, which Nerima-Kasugacho does not. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. A one-room flat costs about ¥5,000 less at Toshimaen. On how easy the shopping is, Toshimaen comes out ahead. Within about 13 minutes' walk, Toshimaen has 11 supermarkets (まいばすけっと and ライフ and others) and Nerima-Kasugacho has 4.
